description: JOB DESCRIPTION: Software Support Engineer - SOLUTIONS WHO WE ARE: Esko is a part of Veralto’s Product Quality & Innovation companies. Collaboration & Learning Work closely with team members, Team Leaders, and other support teams across time zones. Willing to work rotational shifts and weekends as part of scheduled workdays. Willing to work in hybrid mode (office and work‑from‑home) based on team planning. title: IT Support Engineer
description: Sikich is hiring an IT Support Engineer - NOC Analyst to join our Managed Services team. This is an infrastructure and server-side NOC role focused on monitoring, triaging, and supporting client server, network, cloud, and backup environments across multiple clients. The engineer will operate within defined NOC procedures, respond to infrastructure alerts, execute standard troubleshooting for common NOC events such as server, internet, and power outages, and escalate complex issues to senior engineers or US-based on-call consultants when required. Strong ownership, documentation discipline, and clean escalation are core expectations for this role. About the firm Sikich is a global company specializing in Accounting, Advisory, and Technical professional services. With employees across the globe, Sikich ranks as one of the largest professional services companies in the United States. Our comprehensive skillsets, obtained over decades of experience as entrepreneurs, business owners and industry innovators, allow us to provide insights and transformative strategies to help strengthen every dimension of our clients businesses. What will you do in this role? Monitor client infrastructure environments including servers, networks, backups, cloud resources, and endpoint management platforms across multiple clients. Investigate and triage infrastructure alerts related to servers, networking, internet connectivity, power, backups, and availability of business-critical systems. Support Windows Server environments through service and role health checks, event log review, resource utilization checks, disk space monitoring, and basic server-side troubleshooting. Perform Active Directory operations tasks including account status checks, group membership validation, account lockout investigation, and escalation of directory-related issues. Troubleshoot DNS, DHCP, VPN, connectivity, and basic network incidents using standardized diagnostic steps. Troubleshoot basic switching, VLAN, wireless, and firewall connectivity issues using standardized diagnostic steps, and escalate complex network faults to senior engineers or the client's network provider. Perform basic health checks on virtualization platforms such as VMware vSphere or Hyper-V, including VM state, host health, and resource utilization. Monitor backup jobs, investigate backup failures, and escalate restore-related concerns based on documented backup procedures. Monitor patch compliance across servers and endpoints, deploy operating system and third-party updates through RMM tooling, triage patch failures, and coordinate reboots and maintenance windows per documented procedures. Execute NOC runbooks and SOPs for common infrastructure events and escalate cleanly when issues fall outside defined procedures. Coordinate with senior engineers and US-based on-call consultants for complex incidents by providing clear findings, evidence, and troubleshooting steps already performed. Maintain accurate ticket documentation including alert details, business impact, investigation steps, resolution notes, and escalation trail. Provide clear and timely updates to internal teams and clients during incident investigation and resolution. Contribute to knowledge sharing, SOP updates, and continuous improvement of NOC procedures and runbooks. Adhere to company policies, procedures, and SLAs while delivering infrastructure support. Participate in after-hours on-call rotation as required to support client NOC needs outside regular business hours. What do you need to succeed in this role? 2-4 years of experience in Infrastructure Support, NOC Operations, Managed Services, Server Support, or a closely related IT operations role. Hands-on exposure to Windows Server environments and basic server-side troubleshooting. Working knowledge of Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and Group Policy basics. Experience with monitoring platforms and infrastructure alert response. Exposure to patch management and operating system / third-party update deployment through RMM or patch management tooling. Solid understanding of network fundamentals including IP addressing, routing basics, VPN, firewalls, and connectivity troubleshooting. Exposure to backup monitoring, failed backup triage, and restore concepts. Basic understanding of virtualization platforms such as VMware vSphere or Hyper-V. Familiarity with Microsoft 365 and Azure fundamentals, particularly where tied to infrastructure support. Ability to follow SOPs and runbooks and document troubleshooting clearly in a ticketing system. Strong ownership, communication, and escalation discipline in a client-facing Managed Services environment. Experience in a Managed Services Provider (MSP) or multi-client support environment. Hands-on experience with tools such as ConnectWise Manage, ConnectWise Automate/LabTech, LogicMonitor, Datto, or similar PSA / RMM / monitoring / backup platforms. Certifications from Microsoft (Azure Administrator, Windows Server), VMware (VCP), Cisco, Fortinet, or ITIL Foundation. Exposure to firewall, switch, access point, and basic server hardware troubleshooting. Experience supporting after-hours or rotational NOC coverage in an MSP delivery model. Benefits of being a part of the team Family Health Insurance including parents Life & Accident Insurance Maternity/paternity leave Performance-based incentives Referral Bonus program Exam Fee Reimbursement Policy Indian festival holidays 5 days working week Doctor's Consultation

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description: Contributes to the design and architecture of infrastructure and service to ensure reliability and functionality. Responds to infrastructure demands and capacity needs. Collaborates with software development teams to develop of reliable and scalable infrastructures. Contributes to data collection to maintain and optimize operations and reliability. Performs incident response and/or maintenance tasks. Contributes to health and performance reporting. Contributes to identifying opportunities for automation. Communicates relevant details about services and identifies and communicates changes. Provides support for technology and documents incidents. Experiments with new tools and develops working knowledge of site reliability trends. Key Responsibilities Capacity Ingestion and Management: - Contributes to the design and architecture of infrastructure and/or service according to terms for reliability and functionality. - Responds to infrastructure demands and responds to capacity needs, reaching out to immediate team members to help ensure systems have sufficient resources to handle current and future workloads. - Collaborates with the software development team to develop infrastructures in alignment with deployment requirements. - Identifies opportunities for prototyping and participates in prototyping initiatives (e.g., testing new applications or infrastructures, assisting in onboarding). Incident and Service Lifecycle Management: - Contributes to data collection, triage, technical analysis, and redirection to maintain and optimize operations and infrastructure reliability. - Monitors services, maintains up-to-date knowledge of their performance, and documents their condition. - Performs routine incident response and/or maintenance tasks on assigned services (e.g., software installs, version upgrades, security updates, backup and recovery) and gathers information for root cause analyses, with general guidance. - Contributes to health and performance reporting and actions taken based on trends in data. - May perform provisioning to support infrastructure, applications, and services, with general guidance. - May perform decommissioning (e.g., shutting down servers, removing data from databases) to remove objects that are no longer needed. Automation: - Contributes to identifying opportunities for automation and assessing potential benefits. - Contributes to the development of automation or scripts that provide solutions, gather metrics, monitor, analyze, mitigate, or remediate issues/defects within infrastructures. - Follows general guidance to conduct testing to ensure automation performs tasks correctly and produces expected results, and makes necessary revisions, with limited supervision. Technical Communication and Guidance: - Communicates relevant details regarding the scale, capacity, security, and performance attributes of services and technology within immediate team. - Identifies and communicates infrastructure, feature, and tool changes within immediate team. Troubleshooting and Resolution: - Provides operational support for technology, escalating incidents and other routine issues arising within Oracle services. - Participates in on-call shifts to address issues. - Contributes to the resolution of technical issues for a service, investigating and debugging products in order to reach SLOs (service level objectives). - Documents incidents and performs root cause analyses according to standard reporting methods. - Contributes to post-mortem procedures to prevent incident reoccurrence. Innovation and Improvement: - Experiments with new tools and technologies to improve infrastructure performance, reliability, and adherence to security standards, with general guidance. - Identifies and/or executes improvements for performance bottlenecks and deployments, striving for efficient resource utilization, speed, and scalability. - Develops working knowledge of site reliability trends and shares new insights and information with immediate team members. - Performs analyses and provides clear data on production to support business development decisions (e.g., design changes), with limited supervision. Core Responsibilities Planning & Execution: - Tracks timelines with minimal supervision, ensuring work is completed in a timely manner and is in alignment with project requirements. Prioritizes and adjusts work as resources or timelines change, with some guidance. Collaboration & Partnership: - Collaborates within a team to better understand expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages a foundational understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build partnerships with limited guidance. Actively listens and asks questions to enhance collaboration. Problem Solving: - Identifies and addresses issues, escalating problems to senior staff as needed in accordance with standard procedures. Compiles and reviews data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Continuous Learning: - Seeks opportunities to gain knowledge and learn new skills and/or tools aligned with industry trends and best practices. Utilizes feedback and training to improve skills. Participates in a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing. Continuous Improvement: - Implements updates to processes, protocols, and workflows to increase efficiency and effectiveness as directed with some guidance. Contributes to ideation for future process improvements.

description: About Refold AI Refold AI is the AI integration platform built for agents, made for modern SaaS companies that need to ship enterprise integrations at scale. The payoff: integrations stop being a bottleneck that costs you deals and burns margin, and become a growth engine. You win the enterprise deals that hinge on them, onboard faster, and scale without an army of consultants. When an integration fails, a workflow behaves unexpectedly, or a customer is blocked, you're the one who finds out why and gets them running again. This is a hands-on support role. Most of your time goes into triaging tickets, debugging integrations across customer systems, and working with Engineering on root-cause fixes. You'll also turn what you learn into docs, tooling and product feedback, so the same issue doesn't come back. What you'll do: Own the support queue Be the first technical responder for customer issues raised through [ticketing tool], email and shared Slack channels. Triage by severity and business impact, and meet response and resolution SLAs. Keep customers updated with clear, honest status until every issue is closed. Debug integrations end to end Investigate failed workflow runs, auth errors, rate limits, field-mapping and schema mismatches, webhook failures, and data-sync gaps between systems like SAP, Oracle, Workday, NetSuite and Salesforce. Read logs, API traces, and run history to isolate root causes, and reproduce issues in test environments. Fix configuration and workflow issues yourself; escalate product bugs to Engineering with clear repro steps, impact and evidence. Handle incidents Act as first responder on high-severity incidents and coordinate between Engineering and the customer. Write post-incident summaries and root-cause analyses that customers can trust. Join an on-call rotation [with partial overlap with US business hours]. Make support scale Write and maintain troubleshooting guides, runbooks, FAQs and help-centre articles. Spot repeat issues and push for product fixes, clearer error messages or self-serve tooling. Use AI agents and automation, including Refold itself, to speed up triage, diagnosis and routine support work. Be the voice of the customer Tag and trend tickets, and share top issues and feature requests with Product every sprint/month. Help customer teams adopt good support practices and self-serve resources after go-live. What we're looking for: 2–5 years in technical support, product support, support engineering or integration engineering at a B2B SaaS company. A strong grasp of REST APIs, webhooks, JSON and HTTP, plus authentication methods like OAuth 2.0 and API keys. Comfort debugging with Postman, cURL and browser dev tools, and reading application logs. Working knowledge of SQL and a scripting language such as Python or JavaScript; you can read code to follow what a workflow is doing. An understanding of data mapping and transformation between systems with different data models. Experience with a support or ticketing tool such as Zendesk, Intercom, Freshdesk or Jira Service Management. Clear, calm written communication, especially when a customer's production workflow is down. A bias for ownership: you follow an issue through to resolution instead of handing it off. Nice to have: Hands-on experience with enterprise systems such as SAP, Oracle, Workday, NetSuite, Salesforce or HubSpot. Experience with iPaaS or embedded integration platforms such as Workato, MuleSoft, Boomi, Paragon or Merge. Familiarity with LLM-based or agentic workflows and how to debug them. Exposure to cloud and observability tools: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Datadog, Grafana or Sentry. Experience at an early-stage startup where you helped build support processes from scratch.
